test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

The new recruit was ______ to impress his superiors.
solution: The correct answer is** "eager"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let's see the meanings of the given words- • **Sincere- **free from pretense or deceit; proceeding from genuine feelings. ढोंग या छल से मुक्त; वास्तविक भावनाओं से आगे बढ़ना। • **Cordial- **friendly, but formal and polite. दोस्ताना, लेकिन औपचारिक और विनम्र • **Eager- **wanting very much to do or have something, especially something interesting or enjoyable बहुत कुछ करने या कुछ करने के लिए चाहते हैं, विशेष रूप से कुछ दिलचस्प या सुखद • **Intend- **to have as a plan or purpose एक योजना या उद्देश्य के रूप में होना • Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is 'eager' i.e. Option 3. **The complete sentence is-** *The new recruit was **eager** to impress his superiors.* 39:T56b, The Correct answer is "**Pack"**
